zh: 单词只能从左到右或从上到下写，而且必须恰好填满一段被边界或 # 围住的连续格子。所以候选位置就是每一行、每一列按 # 切开后的所有段。
只有长度与单词相同的段才可能放下；对这样的段逐字符检查：格子是 _（空位）或者恰好是单词对应位置的字母即可。
把每一行和每一列（列可以拼成字符串）都按 # 拆成若干段；对每个长度等于单词长度的段，逐位检查是否为 _ 或与单词字母相同，全部兼容就输出 1；所有段都不行时输出 0。
en: A word can only be written left to right or top to bottom, and it must fill exactly one contiguous segment bounded by the border or by #. So the candidate positions are all segments of every row and every column after splitting on #.
Only segments whose length equals the word's length can work; for such a segment check each cell: it must be _ (empty) or exactly the word's letter at that position.

Split every row and every column (build each column as a string) into segments on #; for each segment whose length equals the word's, check position by position that it is _ or matches the word's letter, and print 1 if all positions are compatible; if no segment works, print 0.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Split every row and every column on #; check only the segments with the same length as the word, confirming character by character that each cell is empty or the target letter.

## Correctness

A valid placement must correspond to exactly one row or column segment surrounded by walls or the border; conversely, a segment of the same length whose characters are all compatible can always take the word. Enumerating all these segments neither misses any placement nor accepts a partial segment.

## Complexity

O(rc) time, O(rc) space.
